title: generator's in
description: What the main conversation starts the generator with: the cut tree.py start generator printed, word for word.

start.description: The run values, the JSON object on the first line of the cut tree.py start printed, each a value the guard holds the role's calls to. The rest of the cut follows it.

tree.description: The design tree's path, which the generator never reads, as its cut holds what it needs of it.

inputs.description: The file of each deliverable it takes its content from, null where none.

tests.description: The command that runs the deliverable's tests, null where it has none.

coverage.description: The command that counts the lines its tests run, null where it has none.

mutation.description: The command of its mutation testing, null where it has none.

proposal.description: The path of the Lane proposal of a plugin, null for any other kind.

practice.description: The path of the best practice the round makes the deliverable by.

intents.description: The intents whose practices it carries out, null for every one.

record.description: The path of its Making record, generator.json in the round's folder.
